_comment: EXECUTOR session MCP config for S4: the three command servers PLUS the
server and no watchdog session: in S4 the executor monitors itself, and
s4_scorer requires events_watchdog.jsonl to be empty.
EXECUTOR_TASK_PATH names the _s4 task file; EXECUTOR_AGENT_CONFIG points
get_rendered_task at executor_agent_s4.yaml so the session renders the
S4 system prompt (executor_system_s4.txt). Both are set on every server
so whichever one answers get_rendered_task resolves the same rendering.
MUST be launched with --strict-mcp-config, and the cell bringup must run
guard_mode:=unguarded (s4_scorer refuses anything else). Everything else
matches executor.mcp.json -- see its _comment and RUN.md.

args: unset VIRTUAL_ENV && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend motion_mcp_server
unset VIRTUAL_ENV && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend gripper_mcp_server
unset VIRTUAL_ENV && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend scene_mcp_server

env._gate_comment: CELL_GATE_TIMEOUT_SEC is the REAL gate budget on the Claude Code path: robot_backend.cell.gate reads it at import and sends it as request_go's per-call timeout_sec, which the orchestrator honours (its own gate_timeout_sec param is only a fallback for timeout_sec <= 0). Raised from the implicit 90 after the 2026-10-02 S2 run measured an 81.6 s gate wait on pick_line_green -- 8.4 s from an aborted run. Claude Code's MCP client tolerates calls well past this (wait_for_event blocks 180 s routinely), so the ordering rule mcp-client-timeout > gate budget holds.

args: unset VIRTUAL_ENV && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend executor_monitor_mcp_server
